Security Center · Wardveil Security 0.7

Security state without false reassurance.

Wardveil Security is the substantive GoreeCloud platform system behind the Security Center: the platform-wide security and protection identity, shared evidence contract, and security-state presentation system. It gives applications a consistent way to present posture, protection state, warnings, recommendations, audit information, and security-focused experiences while leaving technical authority with the systems that actually enforce security. Current Wardveil integration is mandatory for GoreeCloud applications and is part of Stable qualification.

Security architecture

Evidence is stronger than branding.

Wardveil is an integral GoreeCloud platform system, not decorative security branding. Wardveil presents security state; it does not manufacture it, and neither the Security Center nor the Wardveil name substitutes for an implemented control or current authoritative evidence.

Authoritative sources remain authoritative

Authentication, authorization, firewalls, private networking, application controls, vulnerability management, backup, and recovery systems remain responsible for their own technical state.

Missing evidence fails closed

Stale, unavailable, incomplete, conflicting, expired, or unverified required evidence must never be promoted to a passing state.

Data minimization

Shared evidence must not contain reusable secrets, active credentials, private keys, tokens, recovery material, unrestricted diagnostics, or unnecessary personal data.

Conservative aggregation

A summary cannot be more favorable than the weakest required evidence in its represented scope.

Read-only by default

Wardveil does not turn the presentation layer into an unaudited cross-platform remediation channel.

Scoped protection claims

“Protected by Wardveil” is valid only for the explicit scope backed by current authoritative evidence.

Application conformance

Every GoreeCloud application must integrate and remain current with the latest approved Wardveil Security contract. Applicability determines which security capabilities and evidence are required for the application's role; it does not make Wardveil itself optional.

Evidence validity matters

Evidence must remain attributable, current, and within the validity asserted by its producer. A previously passing result does not justify a current protected state after its evidence becomes stale, expires, is superseded, or can no longer be supported.

Normalized states

Five states with explicit meaning.

ProtectedRequired evidence is current, valid, and supports the protected claim for the stated scope.
AttentionAction or review is needed, but the represented scope is not necessarily degraded.
DegradedA required protection or control is not operating at the expected level.
UnknownRequired evidence is missing, stale, expired, unavailable, incomplete, conflicting, or unverified.
Not applicableThe control or evidence does not apply to the represented scope.
Relationship model

One security identity. Clear technical boundaries.

Wardveil Security · Security Center

Platform-wide security identity, evidence contract, status semantics, aggregation rules, protection-state presentation, and their public security surface.

Glaze UI · Design Center

Defines how GoreeCloud interfaces look, feel, adapt, and interact across mobile, tablet, desktop, TV, and web surfaces; Stable 1.5 is the current production target.

Privacy Shield · Privacy Center

The separate mandatory platform-wide privacy identity and shared privacy-control foundation.

Everkeep · Continuity Center

The separate mandatory resilience, backup and recovery, preservation, portability, succession, continuity, and digital-legacy identity.

GoreeCloud Mesh · Mesh Center

Coordinates explicit service relationships, evidence exchange, and dependency context without becoming the security authority or upgrading Wardveil state.

Wardveil branding itself is never evidence that a security control succeeded. Security, privacy, resilience, design, and coordination remain complementary platform systems with different responsibilities, and an application cannot claim Stable while required integration is missing or unaccepted.

Presentation semantics

Color can communicate state, but it cannot prove protection.

Wardveil maps normalized security states into Glaze UI semantic color roles for consistent presentation. The mapping is presentation-only and must remain paired with labels, icons, or other non-color cues where meaning matters. A favorable color cannot create or strengthen a protected claim beyond the current Wardveil evidence.

Public status principle

Unknown is more trustworthy than invented certainty.

Wardveil deliberately preserves unknown, degraded, and attention states when evidence cannot support a stronger claim. Public protection language should never outrun the underlying implementation or validation evidence.

Portfolio adoption

Mandatory does not mean automatically complete.

The platform-wide mandate requires current Wardveil Security integration in every GoreeCloud application, but the mandate itself does not prove that every repository, artifact, deployment, or runtime has completed adoption. Missing, incomplete, superseded, outdated, unverified, unaccepted, or expired required integration blocks Stable qualification until corrected and revalidated. Current source and CI enforce the evidence-validity boundary.

Mesh integration

Coordination preserves authority boundaries.

Wardveil publishes security evidence and validity context in a form GoreeCloud Mesh can coordinate across platform relationships. Mesh may transport and relate that context, but it cannot turn missing, expired, degraded, or unknown evidence into a protected state.

Security reporting

Report security issues privately.

Do not publish credentials, tokens, private hostnames, private IP addresses, vulnerability details, or other sensitive operational information in public issues or discussions.

Email security@goreecloud.com
